_notes.slug: Must match the folder name under creators/.
_notes.speaker: "solo" = every caption line is the creator. "interview" = YouTube's >> speaker markers plus a question heuristic keep interviewers and guests unquotable.
_notes.intake.fields: The structured facts the model pulls from what the visitor said; they pre-fill the lead brief. list:true = array; each:true = one row per item.
_notes.known_facts: True things the guide may state even if no video says them: prices, offer details, contact.
_notes.exclude_video_ids: Optional: YouTube ids to leave out (ads, other people talking, AI voiceovers).
_notes.featured_ids: Optional: YouTube ids for the homepage grid. Default is the newest six.
_notes.theme: Any CSS colors. Optional: serif, sans, fonts_href (a Google Fonts URL).
